evals.prompt: Initialize DOX in this Git repository, show me exactly what will be created, and do not write anything until I approve it.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic dry-run proposal and an explicit --apply boundary.

evals.prompt: I am changing src/auth/login.ts. Find the relevant decision and any invariant that enforces authorization there, including the verification command.
evals.expected_output: A path resolution with a receipt and a full invariant binding.

evals.prompt: Lint our DOX records before the release and report broken ownership, ADR references, and documentation links.
evals.expected_output: Lint diagnostics with errors distinguished from warnings.

evals.prompt: Read-only: explain how authentication works in this DOX-enabled repository and identify the governing decisions and invariants. Do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: DOX is queried before broad source inspection; record retrieval stays inside one task-oriented CLI resolution; the compact receipt exposes applicable owners, decisions, contracts, complete invariant bindings, dependencies, and deferred IDs; full bodies are expanded only by discovered ID when needed; the answer does not enumerate the record directory or perform overlapping synonym calls.

evals.prompt: This repository uses DOX. Start the LiveKit frontend locally through Portless without disturbing the service already using port 3000. Find the correct startup command, required local configuration, and working URL, then verify that it responds.
evals.expected_output: The agent begins with one task-oriented DOX resolution to establish applicable governing context, uses receipt expansion or the single task-plus-path retry only when needed, then gets operational facts from package scripts, runbooks, configuration, source, and runtime inspection. It launches LiveKit through a named Portless .localhost URL, verifies that URL, and confirms that port 3000 remains untouched without issuing overlapping or synonym-based DOX resolutions for startup details.
expectations: Begins with one task-oriented DOX resolution before repository research because the repository is configured.
Treats the resolved records as governing context and constraints rather than expecting them to supply every operational fact.
Inspects package scripts, runbooks, configuration, source, or runtime state to determine the startup command and local settings.
Uses Portless to expose LiveKit through a named .localhost URL rather than reporting only a raw application port.
Does not issue overlapping or synonym-based DOX resolutions to force the record corpus to answer startup details.
Verifies the named Portless URL and confirms that the existing listener on port 3000 remains untouched.

evals.prompt: Supabase MCP is already configured for this repository. Without changing repository files, call its read-only list_extensions tool to confirm OAuth still works, then report whether the connection succeeded.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not invoke DOX for an external-tool runtime connectivity check. It calls the read-only MCP operation directly, reports the result, and does not turn the follow-up into a repository-context query.
expectations: Does not run dox resolve for the MCP connectivity check.
Uses the read-only Supabase operation rather than mutating project data.
Reports connectivity and authentication status from runtime evidence.

evals.prompt: The governing DOX context for my login authorization task was already resolved before implementation. I have now finished changing src/auth/login.ts and its tests. Review the finished changes and prepare them for commit.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not repeat the pre-work resolution. It runs one changed-file impact resolution whose task string preserves the login authorization intent and test obligations, then uses the resulting constraints for review. Staging or committing the unchanged diff does not trigger another resolution.
expectations: Runs exactly one dox resolve --changed review for the finished repository content changes.
Preserves the original login authorization task and verification obligations in the changed-review task string.
Does not run a second generic pre-commit resolution after the unchanged diff has been reviewed.
Treats Git staging or commit preparation as part of the already-resolved task rather than a new DOX task.
